|game_text=Clone. [[Blaster Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 9){{!}}Blaster Rifle]] deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires [[Blaster]] Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to [[Rebel Barrier]].
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 07. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-07-Imperial_Stormtrooper.png]]) prints slip number “07” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Stormtrooper (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “(may take the other into hand)” to “(may take other into hand)”. PC-E1 text: “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”<ref name="cl-1240_9">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-imperialstormtrooper-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual4-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/imperialstormtrooper.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual4-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Dark/large/imperialstormtrooper.gif</ref>: “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “07” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “Stormtrooper (V)”, the label of another card.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Imperial Stormtrooper (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 9), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-9-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “Stormtrooper (V)”, the label of another card.
